profile.summary: Al Engineer and Data Scientist with a proven academic track record (published in Q1 SCI journals and international conferences) and practical experience in Deep Learning, hybrid architectures, and data pipeline optimization. Seeking an AI Engineer role at leading technology enterprises to translate rigorous research into scalable solutions, drive datadriven decisions, and contribute to innovative commnercial products. Short-term Goal: To deploy advanced AI algorithms and optimize experimental data pipelines within the technology and telecommunications sectors, ensuring theoretical accuracy translates into real-world efficiency. Long-term Goal: To evolve into an Al Architect or Technical Lead who seamlessly merges academic innovation with business strategy, establishing frameworks where research contimuously elevates commercial ecosystems.

responsibilities_and_impact: Automated data collection from multiple sources, ensuring privacy compliance.
Developed RAG-based chatbot for sales consultations and automated customer data tools using Minl O and Dify.
Designed secure storage systems and fine-tuned models for personalized recommendations.

project_evidence: Demonstrated exceptional label efficiency (58.48% Accuracy, 0.3504 NMI) using only 0.5% labeled data for mapping. Engineered an automated topic classification system for over 580,000 unlabeled Facebook posts by integrating the MPNet language model with the Deep Embedded Clustering (DEC) unsupervised learning algorithm.

Built an end-to-end facial attribute analysis pipeline (age, gender, emotion) for consumer behavior tracking, utilizing MTCNN for face alignment, a ResNet18 backbone for classification, and SQLite for automated data storage.
Developed and containerized a 7-day weather forecasting web application using Flask and Docker, implementing Random Forest algorithms to process historical API data from Visual Crossing.
Fine-tuned a YOLO-based segmentation model for dermatological analysis, designing the dataset strategy and building robust training and evaluation pipelines.

Developed a smart camera-based elderly monitoring system, building an LSTM model to classify 5+ health‑related actions (e.g., fall detection) using MediaPipe pose landmarks extracted from RGB frames. Deployed a lightweight Flask‑based application prototype for real‑time visualization and abnormal behavior notifications.
